sources.name: C. F. Martin & Co. Serial/Date Lookup
sources.use: Authority for Martin guitar and ukulele year-to-last-serial production-year ranges.
scope_notes: Use only the Guitars & Ukuleles table for the standard Martin range dataset.
The official page has separate Little Martin, Backpacker, mandolin, solid wood ukulele, and HPL ukulele tables; those are excluded from this dataset until separate instrument-family rules exist.
The official page notes serials 900001 through 902908 are excluded from the 2002 guitar/ukulele range because they were used on Sigma-Martins in 1981-1982.
product_boundary: May support descriptive production-year lookup by official serial range.
Must not claim authentication, model identity, legal status, valuation, or exact build date from serial number alone.

sources.name: Decoding a Taylor Guitar's Serial #
sources.use: Authority for Taylor 10-digit, 9-digit, 11-digit, 4-prefix, and published pre-1993 serial decoding rules.
scope_notes: Current 10-digit serials started in November 2009 and identify factory, start date, and daily production sequence.
9-digit serials apply from 1993 through 1999.
11-digit serials apply from January 2000 through October 2009.
4-prefix serials apply only to the early 410 model numbering system for 1991 and 1992.
Published older ranges before 1993 are range-based and Taylor notes early record keeping was spotty.
product_boundary: May support descriptive Taylor production/start-date lookup by official serial format.
Must not claim authentication, legal status, valuation, exact model identity, or repair/warranty eligibility from serial number alone.

sources.name: PRS Guitars Year Identification
sources.use: Authority for PRS year-code prefixes, set-neck serial number ranges, and S2 serial number ranges.
scope_notes: The first AMG Decoder PRS implementation covers set-neck and S2 model serial ranges only.
PRS documents many additional families, including CE, EG, Swamp Ash Special, bass, SE, acoustics, amplifiers, and cabinets; those require separate family-specific flows.
The official 2023 set-neck row appears anomalous relative to adjacent ranges and is quarantined until clarified by authority evidence.
The official S2 boundary serial S2043719 appears in both 2019 and 2020 rows and is quarantined until clarified by authority evidence.
product_boundary: May support descriptive PRS set-neck and S2 approximate production-year lookup by official prefix or family sequence range.
Must not claim authentication, exact model identity, valuation, or family identity beyond the user-selected scoped rule.

sources.name: Gibson Serial Numbers
sources.use: Authority for scoped Gibson USA, Gibson Acoustic, Gibson Memphis, Gibson Custom, Les Paul Classic, and selected reissue serial-number formats.
scope_notes: Use only Gibson guitar serial formats documented on the official Gibson serial-number page.
Artist signature models are excluded because Gibson says they often deviate and directs users to contact Gibson.
Epiphone guitar formats are implemented as a separate scoped brand because Gibson documents them on the same source page.
Dobro and banjo formats are excluded until separate brand/family flows exist.
Custom Shop last-digit year formats expose only a production-year digit unless additional authority resolves the decade.
product_boundary: May support descriptive production-year, production-year digit, day-of-year, sequence, batch, and documented family hints from official Gibson formats.
Must not claim authentication, valuation, ownership, legal status, exact model identity, or a full Custom Shop year when Gibson only documents a last digit.

sources.name: Gibson Serial Numbers: Epiphone section
sources.use: Authority for scoped Epiphone guitar serial formats documented by Gibson.
scope_notes: Use only Epiphone guitar formats documented on Gibson's official serial-number page.
Factory code letters are returned as codes only; community factory-code name mappings are not encoded.
Dobro, banjo, and undocumented Epiphone exceptions are excluded until separate source-backed flows exist.
product_boundary: May support descriptive Epiphone production-year/month, factory-code, model-tier hint, and rank parsing from official Gibson-documented formats.
Must not claim authentication, exact factory identity, valuation, ownership, legal status, or exact model identity.

sources.name: How can I find out when my American-made instrument was manufactured?
sources.use: Authority for U.S.-made Fender instrument serial dating ranges and modern US-prefix decoding.
scope_notes: Use only American-made Fender instrument serial schemes from the official Fender support article.
The official page warns that serial numbers overlap and are not precisely definitive because of modular production.
American Vintage V-prefix serials can identify a U.S. Vintage/American Vintage candidate, but Fender says a specific year requires checking the neck heel production date.
Special-run, export, Custom Shop, Japan, Korea, Indonesia, acoustic, amplifier, and non-U.S. serials are excluded from this U.S. authority entry.
product_boundary: May support approximate U.S.-made Fender production-year or production-year-range lookup by official serial pattern.
Must not claim authentication, valuation, exact production date, country of origin beyond the scoped U.S.-made rule, or exact model identity.

sources.name: How can I find out when my Mexican-made instrument was manufactured?
sources.use: Authority for Mexican-made Fender instrument MN, MZ, and MX prefix production-date ranges.
scope_notes: Use only the MN0-MN9, MZ0-MZ9, and MX10-MX17 serial formats explicitly charted on Fender's Mexican-made support article.
Fender warns that year ranges typically overlap because of transition periods and neck or complete-instrument carryover.
The late-2009 10-prefix Mexico transition format is excluded because Fender says the serial body does not identify country of origin and requires the headstock decal.
MSN, MSZ, pre-2010 MX artist-model exceptions, AMXN shared U.S./Mexico California Series instruments, and other special cases are excluded until separate scoped flows exist.
product_boundary: May support approximate Mexican-made Fender production-year-range lookup by official serial pattern.
Must not claim authentication, exact production date, exact model identity, valuation, warranty eligibility, or country of origin outside the scoped prefix evidence.

sources.name: How can I find out when my Indonesian-made instrument was manufactured?
sources.use: Authority for scoped Indonesian-made Fender IC and ICF prefix production-date ranges.
scope_notes: Use only the IC08, IC09, ICF09, IC10, ICF10, and ICF11 serial formats explicitly charted on Fender's Indonesian-made support article.
Fender says the remaining six digits are a unit identifier, are not sequential, and do not provide further identification information.
Fender warns that numbers for each year typically overlap by a few months because of transition periods and serial-numbered inventory carryover.
The post-2012 serial-location guidance is excluded from analyzer rules because it is not a serial-to-date table.
product_boundary: May support approximate Indonesian-made Fender production-year-range lookup by official IC or ICF prefix pattern.
Must not claim authentication, exact production date, exact model identity, valuation, warranty eligibility, ownership, or country of origin outside the scoped prefix evidence.

sources.name: How can I find out when my Japanese-made instrument was manufactured?
sources.use: Authority for Japanese-made Fender serial context requirements and future Japan-specific dating rules.
scope_notes: Fender warns that records on early Japanese-made instruments are not complete and serial numbers are a guide only.
Many Japanese-made letter prefixes overlap other Fender serial families and require Made in Japan or Crafted in Japan decal context.
JD plus eight digits requires Made in Japan decal context and has 2012 transition-period exceptions.
Use this source for context-required guidance only until the analyzer has explicit country/decal intake.
product_boundary: May support non-decoding context guidance for possible Japanese-made Fender serials.
Must not return a Japanese production year, exact model identity, authentication, valuation, warranty eligibility, ownership, or country of origin without reviewed context intake.

sources.name: Collings FAQ: Serial Number Questions
sources.use: Authority for Collings electric serial format and acoustic ship-date contact guidance.
scope_notes: Use the official electric serial structure: general series/model designation, two-digit production-start year, and category sequence.
Official examples include 290181443 and I35LC232197.
Production-start year is not necessarily ship year.
Acoustic exact ship-date information requires contacting Collings with the serial number.
product_boundary: May support descriptive Collings electric production-start year, model-prefix hint, and category sequence parsing.
May support records-assisted Collings acoustic lookup guidance without returning an acoustic production year.
Must not claim authentication, exact model identity, exact ship date, legal status, ownership, or value.
